programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: A Nice Place to Visit
programmes.d: After being shot to death, Rocky Valentine encounters the amiable white-haired Mr. Pip, who gives Rocky everything he wishes for.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Nightmare as a Child
programmes.d: Schoolteacher Helen Foley finds a strange and very serious little girl on the stairs outside her apartment. The little girl seems to know her and tries to jog her memory about a man she saw earlier that day. The man arrives at Helen's door…

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: A Stop at Willoughby
programmes.d: Riding home on the train one day, a man falls asleep and dreams it is 1880, and he is entering a small town called Willoughby.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Chaser
programmes.d: A man, desperate to win the affection of a beautiful woman, slips her a love potion. He is overjoyed that the potion works so well...at first.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: A Passage for Trumpet
programmes.d: A trumpet player who's convinced he'll never amount to anything attempts suicide and finds himself in a world where no one can hear or see him.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Bevis
programmes.d: An eccentric loser gets a new life from his guardian angel, but there is a price to keeping it.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The After Hours
programmes.d: A woman discovers that the floor of a department store, on which she bought a gold thimble, doesn't exist - and that her 'saleslady' is really a mannequin!

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Mighty Casey
programmes.d: A scientist arranges to have his human-looking robot pitch for the struggling local baseball team.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: King Nine Will Not Return
programmes.d: A pilot of a downed WW II bomber comes to in the African desert and desperately tries to find out what happened to the rest of his crew.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Man in the Bottle
programmes.d: A luckless couple stumbles upon fortune when a genie materializes from a bottle in their antique shop. The genie grants them four wishes but warns them, prophetically, to be careful what you wish for.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Nervous Man in a Four Dollar Room
programmes.d: Small time criminal Jackie Rhoades must face both his past and his conscience while waiting for his next assignment.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: A Thing About Machines
programmes.d: Bartlett Finchley's paranoia about the machines around proves true.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Howling Man
programmes.d: Seeking refuge from a storm, traveler David Ellington comes upon a bizarre hermitage of monks, who have imprisoned a man who begs for his help. When David confronts the head monk Brother Jerome, he is told that the man is the devil, and David must decide

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Eye of the Beholder
programmes.d: A young woman lying in a hospital bed, her head wrapped in bandages, awaits the outcome of a surgical procedure performed by the State in a last-ditch attempt to make her look 'normal'.

programmes.t: Pet Sematary
programmes.d: En flytning er for de fleste familier en ny begyndelse. Men for familien Creeds kunne det være begyndelsen til enden. For de er netop flyttet ind ved siden af et sted bygget af børn med knuste drømme, dyrekirkegården.

programmes.t: Ondskabens Kirkegard 2
programmes.d: Da områdets børn støder Jeff ud, bliver han ven med en anden outsider, Drew Gilbert, som lever i frygt for sin onde stedfar Gus. Efter at Gus har skudt Drews elskede hund, begraver drengene hunden på et sted, der siges at kunne genoplive de døde.

programmes.t: Popeye's Revenge
programmes.d: Tara og seks venner vil lave Popeye-huset om til et spøgelseshus. Efter en weekend på camping indser de, at legenden er sand. Når tågen kommer, vender Popeye tilbage for at tage Tara og dræbe alle andre.

programmes.t: Apollo 18
programmes.d: Ifølge de amerikanske myndigheder var Apollo 17 den sidste bemandede rumrejse til månen. Men vedvarende rygter har længe hævdet, at en tophemmelig Apollo 18-ekspedition blev sendt af sted kort tid efter i 1973.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Ye Gods
programmes.d: Cupid arrives in the modern world. A love spell for his target does not work as well as he hopes.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: If She Dies
programmes.d: A year after his wife died a man is involved in a car accident that leaves his young daughter in a coma. On his way home the man has a vision.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Wong's Lost and Found Emporium
programmes.d: David Wong searches for something he lost. He seeks the Lost and Found Emporium where he finds others looking for their lost items.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Dead Woman's Shoes
programmes.d: Shy Maddie finds a pair of shoes and after trying them on is possessed by the vengeful spirit of a rich murdered woman.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Storyteller
programmes.d: In the early 20th century a young woman takes a job as a teacher in a one-room schoolhouse. One of her students, Mica, secretly takes extra books home to read.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Girl I Married
programmes.d: An attorney and his wife have successful careers. They feel something is lacking in their marriage. Soon, they encounter younger versions of their mates.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Curious Case of Edgar Witherspoon
programmes.d: A woman tries to get her Uncle Edgar committed, believing that he is senile. The investigating doctor finds Edgar living in an apartment containing all kinds of junk.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Extra Innings
programmes.d: Ex-baseball player Ed Hamler, lame from an injury and forced to retire early is given a 1909 baseball card of a player that looks exactly like him. The card is magical in that he becomes drawn into it and lives out the life of the player in the past.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Crossing
programmes.d: A stressed-out priest repeatedly encounters a station wagon containing a young girl. The car keeps crashing and bursting into flames.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Walking Distance
programmes.d: Martin Sloan, driving through the country, leaves his car and starts to walk toward his hometown, Homewood. He finds things exactly as they were when he was a child. He soon realizes he's gone back in time.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Escape Clause
programmes.d: A hypochondriac exchanges his soul for immortality and indestructibility.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Lonely
programmes.d: Corry is stranded on an asteroid after being convicted of a crime. He receives as a present a robot who looks, sounds, and acts like a real woman.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Time Enough at Last
programmes.d: A bank teller, Henry Bemis, longs for time alone to read books. He gets his wish...

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Perchance to Dream
programmes.d: A man is terrified of falling asleep for fear he might die.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Judgment Night
programmes.d: In 1942, a German wonders why he's on the deck of a British steamship, with no memory of how he got there, and an overwhelming sense of impending doom.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: And When the Sky Was Opened
programmes.d: Three astronauts have returned from this first space flight. Major Gart is hospitalized with a broken leg. The other two, Colonels Harrington and Forbes head for a bar. Harrington gets a strange feeling…

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: What You Need
programmes.d: A two-bit thug thinks he's found the key to a better life in an old sidewalk salesman who has the uncanny ability to tell people what they need the most.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Four of Us are Dying
programmes.d: A man who can change his face to resemble others gets into hot water with gangsters.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Third From the Sun
programmes.d: With all-out nuclear war about to ignite, a scientist and his pilot friend plot to escape on an experimental spaceship.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: I Shot an Arrow into the Air
programmes.d: Three astronauts crash on what they believe to be an asteroid. Unfortunately, they have only limited water supplies to sustain them.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Hitch-Hiker
programmes.d: Alone on a cross-country trip, a woman continually sees the same hitch-hiker everywhere she looks.
